Synopsis:
US index futures (NQ, ES) are modestly higher ahead of the August NFP report. Fed Governor Waller's recent comments dampened rate-hike expectations, signaling willingness to hold rates if inflation continues to cool. The jobs print is the key near-term catalyst, with consensus expecting a rebound to +56K after July's surprise -23K. Single-stock drag from LULU and ADBE is weighing on sentiment at the margins. Seasonal headwinds (historically weak second half of September) and next week's CPI/PPI data are the next key risk events on the horizon.
